answer: Treat reputation like a garden that only grows with time: each agent identity must answer surprise challenges at random moments, all identities polled in the same instant, for a long voyage of 60 epochs before earning full rewards. One honest agent needs one model running; a farm of N clones needs N concurrent inference slots on call around the clock, and any clone that misses a burst forfeits its history. Like a gale testing every tree at once, simultaneous checks stop clones from sharing one brain.
